gen-nixie-one-gf-epunda-slab: Hairline-thin, evenly stroked letters with gaps in every curve give Nixie One its retro-tech look. And Epunda Slab, the classic serif underneath, brings a tall, rounded lowercase and a visibly gaping c that feel dignified.
gen-nixie-one-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One has a tall middle band, short ascenders and descenders, and an e that opens generously toward the eye. Under Nixie One it reads in a literary, dignified way.
gen-nixie-one-gf-glegoo: Nixie One draws every curve at a constant stroke, with no swelling in the middle, which gives it a nostalgic, retro-tech feel. But Glegoo, a classic serif, is the real draw: big counters and unclosed curves in a tall lowercase make it refined and editorial.
gen-nixie-one-gf-hanuman: Nixie One looks nostalgic and retro-tech, its open curves drawn with a constant stroke from top to baseline. Hanuman, a traditional text serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, carries a refined feel across a long page.
gen-nixie-one-gf-kadwa: Nostalgic stencil-cut letters of one steady width make Nixie One a heading with real character, while its open curves stay clear. Kadwa, a text serif with a larger-than-usual x-height and open-ended curves, is the one built for classic, editorial reading.
gen-nixie-one-gf-noticia-text: Nixie One gives headings a retro-tech look with open curves and no thin strokes vanishing in glare. And Noticia Text, a text serif whose lowercase fills most of the letter height, keeps a long passage literary and dignified.
gen-nixie-one-gf-piazzolla: Retro-tech and wiry, Nixie One draws its open curves at a constant stroke. Piazzolla, a classic serif with lowercase nearly matching its capitals and an e opened like a pried clasp, looks best with the body text sized a bit larger.
gen-nixie-one-gf-pridi: Pridi reads as a refined text serif, with generous space between curve ends and stems and small letters standing proud, almost capital-sized. Nixie One, nostalgic and retro-tech, sits above it with open curves and a constant stroke.
gen-nixie-one-gf-scope-one: Scope One pairs a big x-height with stubby ascenders and descenders, and its counters spill out into the surrounding space. A long read in this classic serif feels traditional and refined.
gen-nixie-one-gf-slabo-13px: Nixie One has bowls as heavy as its stems, so every nostalgic, retro-tech curve is drawn with the same constant stroke. Slabo 13px, a classic serif with large open counters in a, e and s, brings the bookish, dignified side.
